Plan Your Visit

You’re not alone in this.

Whatever brought you here — curiosity, hope, doubt, or just a friend who wouldn’t stop inviting you — you’re welcome.

Church isn’t for perfect people.

It’s for people who know they need something more. If that’s you, pull up a chair.

01

You don’t need to have it all figured out.

02

You won’t be put on the spot.

03

You can take it at your own pace.

What to expect

01

Arrive

Doors open 30 min before. Coffee in the foyer.

02

Settle in

Find a seat. No assigned seating. Sit wherever you’re comfortable.

03

The service

Songs, a talk from the Bible, prayer. ~75 min.

04

Afterwards

Coffee and conversation. Or slip out the back — no pressure.

Questions you might have

What if I don’t know anyone?

Look for the welcome team in blue shirts. They’ll introduce you around.

Will I be asked to give money?

No. If you’re a guest, please don’t feel any pressure to give.

What if I cry?

That’s okay. We’ve all been there.

I’ve been hurt by church before.

We’re sorry. We want to do better. Come see.

I’m not sure I believe in God.

That’s exactly why you should come. Ask your questions.

Meet the pastors

Photo

Pastor David Mokoena

We’d love to meet you.

Come this Sunday. We’ll be looking for you.
